svg.text: An open dashed notehead (R = 3.0pt) standing exactly where
the unvoiced note would have been, carrying the score’s own
duration grammar: a monoline stem with one downward-hooked
flag for an 8th, two for a 16th, the bare stem for a
quarter and a calm hollow dashed bar for a half. The
silence keeps the melodic contour of the line it interrupts
— the eye reads the missing note, not an abstract pause.
The system opens on the standardized flared 0.65pt
